text.en: Clients consistently praise Amit for his in-depth expertise in canine psychology and his calm, empathetic teaching style. Reviewers note that he quickly puts stressed dog owners at ease by explaining behavioural causes clearly and demonstrating practical techniques. Pet owners appreciate his personalised advice tailored to individual dogs.

Dog owners report remarkable improvements in house training, crate habits, and loose-lead walking within days of starting lessons. Reviewers highlight that structured training plans turn overwhelming puppy challenges into manageable daily routines. Many clients note long-term success walking dogs off-lead and managing real-world distractions.

Reviewers emphasize how effectively the group classes and private sessions help energetic or boisterous puppies learn social manners. Amit is praised for showing owners how to channel canine enthusiasm positively and build healthy focus around other dogs and people. Clients note that pets emerge well-rounded, balanced, and confident.

q.en: What training services are provided by Woofology?

a.en: The business provides private one-to-one home consultations, puppy foundation coaching, and group socialisation classes.

q.en: How quickly do clients see training results?

a.en: Reviewers report significant progress within one to two weeks, particularly for puppy toilet training and basic focus.

q.en: Are training methods tailored to specific dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize that training is customised to each individual dog's temperament and household lifestyle.

q.en: How do reviewers view the cost of training packages?

a.en: Clients consider the training investment worthwhile given the rapid, lasting behavioural improvements achieved.
